notes: «قال وحدثنا عبد الله بن عبد الرحمن» starts a second isnad with the same saying: a second group, not a variant

the first isnad's text ends at «قيس بن الحجاج» and writes no names after it; its tail is not written, so the first group stops there and no shared tail is set (the tail rule applies only after «ح», «قالا» or «جميعا»)
«المعنى، واحد» is an editor's gloss and is left out; Tirmidhi's «قال أبو عيسى» remark is not chain
